Proven with two real mimid binaries on loopback, enforce mode (crates/mimid-server/tests/mtls_binaries.rs): PKIX both directions with mimid terminating TLS (b-\u003ea updateConsent, submitMessage, groupInfo, update; a-\u003eb keyMaterial, notify), each logged mechanism=pkix with the sender's key id; refusals for no cert, wrong-domain cert, unknown CA, expired cert (403 + Accept-Signature, exact reasons logged); trusted proxy ([trusted_proxy] at 127.0.0.2, X-Client-Cert honored from the proxy only); DANE-EE and DANE-TA b-\u003ea with a stub TLSA resolver (binary's hickory resolver validates from the real root, so no local DNSSEC zone without a code change), refusing another key, insecure answer, no records. No bugs found in the mTLS code. Added an endpoint field to provider-auth log events. Test plan: docs/interop/mtls-test-plan.md. Still to do: the real-peer test (Haven/Rohan/Konrad), DANE through real DNSSEC, and check reviewcommit.com is DNSSEC-signed at Epik before offering DANE."}

new_value: {"notes":"2026-11-22: one of the three remaining items is ANSWERED. 'Check reviewcommit.com is DNSSEC-signed at Epik before offering DANE' -- it is. Verified from joumon: DS at the parent (25774 13 2 CCECA9CA...), resolvers set the ad flag, and the provider key TXT RRset carries an RRSIG by key 25774. So DANE is offerable on our side as far as the zone goes. What is still missing for DANE is the record itself: no TLSA at _mimi._client.mimi.reviewcommit.com (checked, empty), so mimid publishes no DANE client-certificate record yet. That is optional -- the RFC 9421 DNS-key mechanism is primary and works -- and only matters if a peer wants to authenticate us by DANE. Remaining: the real-peer test, and DANE through real DNSSEC."}
